title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Pipeline Punch Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pipeline Punch is a tropical fruit blend bursting with the sweetness of Pineapple and Mango balanced by a light citrus tang. The result is a smooth, vibrant vape with a bright, juicy finish that’s both sweet and refreshing. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod linked to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no messy refilling or coil changes—just attach it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coil design ensures consistent flavour delivery for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
